detail: Story says the page shows exactly `Order not found`; TC-06/07/10 assert only that the page 'shows the text'. Each should assert the `.order-details-notfound` element's full text equals `Order not found` (TC-07 and TC-10 should name the element as TC-06 does).

'created through the fixture as alice' does not say how the order is created (DB seed vs CreateOrder API call) nor list its item name, street and city, so the 'response body does not contain' assertion has no concrete strings; name the setup mechanism and the exact values.
